body:
allow_registration: bool = True on create_blueprint. When False: POST /register
returns 403 registration_disabled with a clear message (Android surfaces the
message via its existing ApiException path); the web login page disables the
"Need an account? Register" toggle and shows "Registration is disabled on this
server." — the SPA learns the flag from the same serve-time window.__APP_CONFIG__
injection that T-60 adds for the mount root.
title: create_blueprint flag to disable new-account registration (API 403 + web notice)
